1→# CLAUDE.md
     2→
     3→## Project
     4→
     5→thos is a visual orchestration layer for Claude Code — a web UI that runs alongside the CLI providing real-time agent visibility, persistent memory, change management, and task orchestration.
     6→
     7→## Tech Stack
     8→
     9→- Next.js 16 + React 19 + TypeScript (strict mode)
    10→- Standalone WebSocket server (ws, port 9900) for agent relay
    11→- Tailwind CSS 4 + shadcn/ui (new-york style) + Lucide icons
    12→- File-based JSON persistence (.thos/sessions/, .thos/tasks/)
    13→- pnpm 10 package manager
    14→
    15→## Commands
    16→
    17→- `pnpm dev` — Start Next.js (port 3000, Turbopack) + WebSocket server (port 9900) concurrently
    18→- `pnpm dev:next` — Next.js only
    19→- `pnpm dev:ws` — WebSocket server only
    20→- `pnpm build` — Production build
    21→- `pnpm lint` — ESLint
    22→
    23→## Architecture
    24→
    25→- **app/** — Next.js app router pages (dashboard is the main UI)
    26→- **components/dashboard/** — React components for agent sidebar, chat, messages, tasks
    27→- **hooks/use-websocket.ts** — Central React hook managing WS connection and all agent state
    28→- **server/ws.ts** — Standalone WebSocket relay server (agent lifecycle, message routing, persistence)
    29→- **server/session-store.ts** — Debounced file-based agent/session persistence
    30→- **server/task-store.ts** — File-based task persistence
    31→- **lib/types.ts** — Shared TypeScript types (Claude NDJSON protocol + browser↔server messages)
    32→- **middleware.ts** — IP allowlist (localhost + Tailscale)
    33→
    34→Two WebSocket connection families: `/browser` (dashboard tabs) and `/claude/:agentId` (CLI instances).
    35→
    36→## Conventions
    37→
    38→- All interactive components use `"use client"` directive
    39→- Functional components only, hooks for state
    40→- Path alias `@/*` maps to project root
    41→- Dark mode is the default theme
    42→- CSS class merging via `cn()` utility (clsx + tailwind-merge)
    43→- OKLch color space for theme variables
    44→- Debounced persistence (150ms) for streaming events, sync writes for critical state changes
    45→- Message deduplication: Claude CLI sends cumulative snapshots, server stores only final versions
    46→- Unidirectional data flow: useWebSocket hook → page → child components
    47→- All changes must be documented in CHANGELOG.md
    48→- Then well documented in a commit and pushe
    49→-

# CLAUDE.md

## Project

thos is a visual orchestration layer for Claude Code — a web UI that runs alongside the CLI providing real-time agent visibility, persistent memory, change management, and task orchestration.

## Tech Stack
